interactions.target_raw: Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(o) subunit alpha
interactions.note: The epitope of scFv16 on subunits of the heterotrimeric Go protein was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the human α(2B)adrenoceptor-Go-scFv16 complex at a resolution of 2.9Å. The heterotrimeric Go protein consists of human Gαo, rat Gß1 and human Gγ2. The α(2B)AR is bound to sedative sympatholytic dexmedetomidine. The single-chain variable fragment (scFv16)  binds to the interface of the G protein α- and β-subunits, was used to stabilize α2BAR–Go complex.
